title: ExtlRecShrLead - Data API
description: Represents the Lead record of a vendor org if you’re a partner. If you’re a vendor for Partner Connect, this object represents a partner org. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ExtlRecShrCnctId.description: ID of the external record share connection. This field is a relationship field.

LeadId.description: ID of the partner lead. This field is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

special_access_rules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.
